$comment: Options for the pseudo connector. Keys map 1:1 to PseudoConnector.__init__ kwargs (spread by main.create_classes) — keep in lockstep with the constructor; tests/test_config.py enforces this.

emulates.$comment: The transport this replay stands in for, e.g. "mqtt". Devices dispatch on the protocol Config injects into their connector_options; without this they see "pseudo" and refuse the payload. Omit it when replaying only pseudo devices.

step_timeout_seconds.$comment: How long the replay waits for the algorithms to finish a timestep before advancing anyway. 0 disables lockstep (fire-and-forget, non-deterministic); null waits forever.
